methodology.aggregation: median per-stream elapsed time across 7 measured batches
methodology.chunking: UTF-8 serialized payloads are sliced as bytes at exact requested byte widths; cases with fewer than two chunks are omitted
methodology.comparison: all three adapters must produce the same complete Python value and reject NaN, leading-zero numbers, trailing commas, and trailing data
methodology.measurement_resolution: batches target at least 10 ms elapsed when possible; repetitions grow based on observed duration, up to 4096 full streams, and zero-duration batches are retried
methodology.metric: median elapsed seconds per complete parser lifecycle
methodology.numeric_overflow_note: 1e400 is valid JSON number syntax but exceeds finite Python float range; backend numeric-range behavior is recorded separately
methodology.semantic_scope: strict incremental only; complete decoding, cumulative-prefix reparsing, structural finishers, and permissive repair libraries are excluded
methodology.timing_scope: parser construction, every delta-chunk feed/consume-and-poll call, inspection of each partial status/value/error, and finalization; payload construction and reference JSON decoding are outside timing

summary.speedup_definition: Python fallback median elapsed time divided by native median elapsed time; values above 1 mean native is faster
